brief:
Osama Afifa's analysis reveals how UN envoy Mladen­inov bypasses the National Committee for Gaza by pursuing a parallel follow-up process, Shehab Wire reported. The committee has been prevented from functioning due to Israeli obstruction while facing accusations of poor performance.

The parallel track allows the envoy to operate outside the committee's framework, effectively marginalizing the body established to oversee Gaza-related matters. The move comes amid broader questions about institutional dysfunction and the efficacy of international oversight mechanisms in the territory.

title: UN envoy sidelines Gaza committee through parallel track
